name: Bit Blazor UI Playground
onCreateCommand: wget https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/thank-you/sdk-8.0.410-linux-x64-binaries -O $HOME/dotnet.tar.gz && export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet && mkdir -p "$DOTNET_ROOT" && tar zxf $HOME/dotnet.tar.gz -C "$DOTNET_ROOT" && export PATH=$DOTNET_ROOT:$DOTNET_ROOT/tools:$PATH && dotnet dev-certs https --trust
